C dep019.no-build-tooling OL DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Keep build tooling out of production runtime images. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-image-practices EX DEP-019,ARC-002 DEFAULT ;; Keep images reproducible and configuration external, keep Docker concerns out of application architecture (Domain/Application), use platform health probes when practical. ;; = ;; When practical. ;; Container practices outside the oracle (EXC-006).
C x.dk-multistage EX DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Use a multi-stage build for ASP.NET Core Dockerfiles. ;; = ;; none ;; Dockerfile shape is technique outside the oracle.
C x.dk-copy-practices EX - DEFAULT ;; Copy only present build files needed by restore (do not add them to satisfy the Dockerfile); copy project files explicitly without flattening wildcards. ;; = ;; none ;; Dockerfile technique.
C x.dk-restore-caching EX - DEFAULT ;; Copy project/build-dependency files before full source; update the copy section with structure changes; never sacrifice restoring the real project graph for caching. ;; = ;; none ;; Restore caching technique.
C dep019.runtime-image-kind OL DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Use the ASP.NET runtime image for ASP.NET Core and an appropriate .NET runtime image for workers. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-nonroot EX DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Use the built-in non-root user (USER app) when it fits the image and deployment. ;; = ;; When it fits. ;; Beyond DEP-019's 'do not switch to root to bypass problems'.
C dep019.permissions OL DEP-019 MUST ;; Give writable directories appropriate ownership and permissions (instead of root). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-runtime-config EX SEC-002 DEFAULT ;; Pass environment-specific configuration at runtime (ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT, ConnectionStrings__Default, Authentication__Authority). ;; = ;; none ;; Container configuration practice not in the oracle.
C sec001.docker-credentials OL SEC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Real credentials never go into Dockerfiles, committed Compose files, visible build arguments or copied appsettings. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec002.docker-secrets OL SEC-002 DEFAULT ;; Use platform or container secret mechanisms. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.compose-used OL GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Add only infrastructure the project actually uses to Compose. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec002.local-passwords OL SEC-002 MUST ;; Keep local passwords in a local .env or another ignored developer mechanism. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-probes EX API-019 DEFAULT ;; Expose liveness/readiness via ASP.NET Core health checks, prefer orchestrator HTTP probes, do not assume curl/wget/shell in runtime images; verify or add a probe mechanism weighing debug-package cost. ;; = ;; none ;; Probe mechanics outside the oracle (EXC-006).
C x.dk-frontend-container EX - DEFAULT ;; For static frontend deployment build in a Node stage and serve assets with the selected hosting strategy (Nginx not mandatory); keep API base URLs/config compatible. ;; = ;; none ;; Frontend container technique.
C x.dk-dockerignore EX - DEFAULT ;; Exclude non-build content from the build context; do not exclude tests the image build runs or files required by restore/build. ;; = ;; none ;; Build-context hygiene.
C x.dk-image-optimization EX DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Start with standard runtime images; Alpine/chiseled/trimming/Native AOT only when justified, verifying globalization, native dependencies, reflection and diagnostics. ;; = ;; Justified by compatibility/deployment needs. ;; Image optimization discipline (EXC-006).
C x.dk-verify EX WF-006 MUST ;; For Docker changes build the image, verify startup, ports/configuration, non-root behaviour, health probes, review for accidental secrets/files, and run meaningful tests. ;; = ;; As relevant. ;; Docker verification checklist beyond the oracle.

C gov012.proportional-tests OL GOV-012,GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not build test infrastructure without concrete need; a small project needs no enterprise harness; test the risks that matter. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst005.table-preferable OL TST-005 PREFER ;; A longer explicit case table is preferable to a shorter algorithmic test when it makes rules visible. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.tst-boundary-doubles EX TST-003 DEFAULT ;; Mock or fake architectural boundaries when that makes the behaviour under test clearer. ;; = ;; none ;; Mocking technique outside the oracle (EXC-012).
C tst003.app-service-tests OL TST-003,TST-002,TST-006 DEFAULT ;; Test Application Services with controlled doubles asserting results and meaningful side effects; interaction checks only when part of the contract; integration tests when persistence/transactions/DI/serialization/HTTP semantics matter. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst004.testing-env OL TST-004 MUST ;; Configure the Testing environment with isolated resources so integration tests never reach development or production databases. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst007.db-strategy OL TST-007 DEFAULT ;; Provider fidelity matters for provider-specific SQL/constraints/transactions/locking/indexes/raw SQL/mappings/migrations (use the actual provider; Testcontainers is a good option); a lighter isolated relational DB may do when fidelity does not matter, stating the trade-off. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst008.known-state-strategy OL TST-008 MUST ;; Give every test a known state (recreate/reset isolated DB, fitting transactions, minimal seed, unique identifiers). ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst011.meaningful-persistence OL TST-011 MUST_NOT ;; Test repositories/mappings only for meaningful persistence behaviour; no tests for every trivial Add/Get. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run004.fake-time OL RUN-004,TST-004 DEFAULT ;; Read time through TimeProvider and control it with FakeTimeProvider in tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst004.external-doubles OL TST-004 MUST ;; Use fakes/mocks, stub HttpMessageHandler or local fake servers at external boundaries; dedicated sandboxes only when explicitly targeted. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.tst-separate-slow EX TST-004 DEFAULT ;; Keep slow or unreliable external-system tests separate from ordinary fast runs. ;; = ;; none ;; Test-suite partitioning not in the oracle.
C x.tst-data-builders EX TST-008,GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Keep test data explicit and minimal; builders/fixtures only when repeated setup gets hard to read; no generic test-data framework for a few objects. ;; = ;; none ;; Builder technique (EXC-012).
C tst010.convert-probes OL TST-010 MUST ;; Convert temporary probes (HTTP requests, scripts, ad-hoc tests, manual DB checks, regression probes) into maintained tests (e.g. WebApplicationFactory). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.tst-review-probe EX TST-010 MUST ;; Review a temporary probe before keeping it as a permanent test. ;; = ;; none ;; Added review step.
C gov013.no-snapshot-default OL GOV-013,DEP-001 MUST_NOT ;; Do not introduce a snapshot library by default; explicit assertions are usually clearer. ;; = ;; Large stable outputs. ;;
C x.tst-no-assertion-free EX TST-003 AVOID ;; Avoid assertion-free tests unless the behaviour is 'does not throw'. ;; = ;; 'Does not throw' behaviour. ;; Not stated in testing.md or the oracle.
C tst004.no-delays OL TST-004 AVOID ;; Avoid arbitrary delays such as Task.Delay in tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst007.no-needless-testcontainers OL TST-007,GOV-013 AVOID ;; Avoid Testcontainers without a provider-fidelity need and claiming in-memory providers as relational coverage. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep023.test-project-cleanup OL DEP-023,DEP-006 MUST ;; After creating test projects remove properties duplicated by Directory.Build.props and versions duplicated by CPM, at the locations/references project-structure defines. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.tst-nunit-template EX DEP-013 DEFAULT ;; Create test projects with the NUnit template (dotnet new nunit). ;; = ;; none ;; Tooling technique not in the oracle.
C dep013.test-packages OL DEP-013,DEP-003 DECIDED ;; Test packages via add-dependency: NUnit, NUnit3TestAdapter, Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk; Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing for integration tests; Microsoft.Extensions.TimeProvider.Testing when FakeTimeProvider is needed. ;; = ;; none ;;
